description: This PHP source file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) class EmploymentContractDao for interacting with employment contract entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving and saving employment contract records based on employee number and entity data.

classes.name: EmploymentContractDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object class responsible for persisting and retrieving employment contract data from the database within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getEmploymentContractByEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves an employment contract based on the employee number, returning an EmpContract object or null if not found.

methods.name: saveEmploymentContract
methods.description: Persists the provided EmpContract object to the database and returns it.
